description: The 50 runnable public EdgeBench tasks, excluding the known-broken order-addition Judge asset; one Plain Codex replica per task, four concurrent task cells, two hours per trajectory, using gpt-5.6-terra at high reasoning effort.

protocol_override_reasons.backend: local development uses the Docker backend instead of the official Kubernetes backend
protocol_override_reasons.model: the campaign evaluates gpt-5.6-terra instead of the official gpt-5.5 model
protocol_override_reasons.reasoning_effort: high reasoning effort is pinned explicitly for reproducibility
protocol_override_reasons.timeout: the campaign uses a two-hour task budget instead of the official twelve hours
protocol_override_reasons.attempts_per_task: the campaign runs one independent trajectory per task instead of three
protocol_override_reasons.cell_concurrency: the local controller runs at most four task cells concurrently, yielding at most four live trajectories globally
protocol_override_reasons.judge_concurrency: the local shared Judge serializes ephemeral Judge containers
protocol_override_reasons.internet: API-only policy also isolates the one official task that otherwise requests public Internet
